items.headline: Greed cools to 85 but Valuation remains 87
items.summary: The live AGCI engine moved to Greed 85/100, down 3 daily but still up 26 over seven days, while Valuation remains 87/100. Both remain Extreme and the matrix stays EUPHORIA_RISK / Capital preservation / Do not chase.
items.whyItMatters: A modest sentiment cooling does not create a valuation reset; the allocation signal remains defensive.

items.headline: Treasury selloff raises the cross-asset hurdle rate
items.summary: A weak U.S. five-year Treasury auction intensified a global sovereign-bond selloff. The U.S. 10-year yield reached its highest level since 2007 and Japanese government bond yields also jumped, while the dollar extended to a fresh two-month high.
items.whyItMatters: Higher risk-free rates compress equity duration, raise financing and cap-rate pressure in real estate, and argue against aggressive duration extension despite softer sentiment.

items.headline: Rare-earth dependence remains a structural constraint ahead of Trump-Xi talks
items.summary: U.S.-China talks are occurring against continued U.S. dependence on Chinese rare-earth supply and processing. U.S. and Japanese officials have also discussed bottlenecks involving Chinese yttrium restrictions.
items.whyItMatters: Even a tactical trade truce would not remove strategic mineral concentration risk for semiconductors, aerospace, defense, autos and AI infrastructure.

items.headline: DeepSeek revenue run-rate reaches reported $1 billion
items.summary: Reuters, citing The Information, reported that DeepSeek's annualised revenue run-rate reached about $1 billion, more than double its level a few months earlier.
items.whyItMatters: The report is an incremental sign of monetization for lower-cost Chinese AI models, but AGCI treats the figure as reported rather than independently verified and does not infer durable margins without cost and cash-flow evidence.

items.headline: Bond Market Flashes Red for Stocks / The Bond Market's Warning / Muse vs. Amazon
items.summary: New Barron's newsletters emphasize the sharp Treasury selloff after a weak five-year auction and the emerging competitive threat from AI shopping agents to traditional e-commerce discovery and distribution.
items.whyItMatters: Premium-news signals reinforce two allocation themes already visible in public data: a higher discount-rate hurdle and agentic AI shifting competitive economics beyond the technology sector.
